subject: Helix Retail: operational playbook & trial milestones
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Tom Alvarez <t.alvarez@helixretail.com>, Sara Jensen <sara.jensen@helixretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 16:04:00 -0800
Subject: Helix Retail: operational playbook & trial milestones

Tom / Sara — thanks again for a constructive conversation today. Below is a concise recap of what we agreed and proposed next steps so everyone has the same frame going into the technical deep-dive next week. If I missed anything, call it out and I’ll update the MAP.

1) Primary goals (what Helix wants to measure during the 6-week trial)
- Replace current on-prem keyword-matching reranker with a Redwood-powered semantic reranker for product search refinement; target +7–10% conversion lift on test cohorts.
- Reduce median inference latency for cart-recommendation pipeline from ~160ms to <90ms under 95th percentile traffic.
- Verify data isolation requirements for customer PII and KMS integration for model keys.

2) Key pain points you reiterated
- Inference cost spikes during peak hours (holiday traffic)
- Inability to run consistent A/B tests due to latency variability from existing infra
- Auditability & encryption-at-rest for search logs required for compliance audits

3) Proposed trial scope & milestones (high level)
- Week 0 (prep): access + sample dataset delivery (Helix) — target 2027-01-19
- Week 1: baseline profiling & model selection (Redwood) — target 2027-01-26
- Weeks 2–4: integration, KV-cache tuning, and pilot traffic split (Redwood + Helix) — target start 2027-02-02
- Week 5: evaluation window + metrics review (joint) — target 2027-02-23
- Week 6: decision & rollout plan (Helix stakeholders) — target 2027-03-01

4) Decision makers / stakeholders you listed
- Tom Alvarez — Head of Product (final decision)
- Sara Jensen — Director, Search Engineering (technical owner)
- Procurement mailbox (procurement@helixretail.com) — contracting and POs

5) Risks & gating items
- Procurement needs a SOW + SLA addendum referencing data retention and KMS.
- Engineering wants a short deep-dive on KV cache invalidation and request batching patterns (30–45 min).
- Need a quick review of the PCI/PII logging path — is there a gated audit that prevents tokenized payloads?

Attachments: I’ve attached a one-page operational playbook template and a term-sheet stub to make procurement easier.

Next immediate actions (owners):
- Helix: share a ~48–72 hour sample of search logs + expected peak TPS by 2027-01-19 (Tom)
- Redwood: schedule the technical deep-dive with Sara and Eng (Marissa) — propose 2027-01-20 or 2027-01-21 (Ben)
- Redwood: finalize draft SOW + SLA term-sheet to share with procurement by 2027-01-22 (Aditya)

Thanks — I’ll send a calendar invite for the deep-dive when you confirm availability.

Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: redwood-playbook-helix-v1.xlsx; redwood-sla-pricing-term-sheet.pdf
From: Tom Alvarez <t.alvarez@helixretail.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Jensen <sara.jensen@helixretail.com>, procurement@helixretail.com
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 09:17:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Helix Retail: operational playbook & trial milestones

Ben — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming the items below and adding a couple notes from procurement side.

- Timeline: dates look good. We’ll aim to get the sample logs to you by EOD 2027-01-19.
- Stakeholders: adding Jason Lee (Head of Security) to the technical deep-dive; he needs to validate the KMS/HSM approach for key handling. I’m copying him privately to coordinate.
- Procurement: we typically require a standard NDA + SOW before sending production-like logs. Procurement says they can accept a redlined SOW + our standard T&Cs by next Friday. (procurement@helixretail.com)

A couple of clarifications:
- For the evaluation window, we prefer a split test with a 10% traffic slice initially, moving to 25% for the last two weeks if stability looks good.
- Our peak TPS estimate is ~420 TPS for search indexing (holiday spikes ~1.2k TPS but only for short windows).

We’d like the deep-dive next Thursday, 2027-01-21 at 10:00 AM PT if that works for your team. Sara will lead the engineering questions.

Tom Alvarez
Head of Product | Helix Retail
t.alvarez@helixretail.com | +1 (646) 555-0123

Team — quick internal coordination after Tom’s reply. Summary and asks for the enablement/eng side before the 1/21 deep-dive: 

Short-term checklist (owners & due dates)
- SOW/SLA draft (Aditya) — include KMS/HSM language, retention windows, and 95/99 latency SLOs. Target: 2027-01-22.
- Technical deep-dive deck (Marissa) — include a slide on KV cache behavior, batch sizing strategy, and fallback policies for degraded capacity. Target: 2027-01-20 EOD to allow review.
- Traffic-profile playbook (Ben + Marissa) — include recommended traffic-splitting plan: 10% -> 25% -> 50% (roll-forward), and emergency rollback steps. Target: 2027-01-20.
- Security pre-read for Jason Lee (Ben) — short note explaining our KMS integration and audit logs (one page). Target: 2027-01-19.

Proposed MAP (mutual action plan) — condensed for Tom / Sara / procurement:
- 2027-01-19: Helix sends anonymized sample logs & security contact (Tom)
- 2027-01-21: Technical deep-dive (Redwood eng + Helix eng) — 45 minutes, agenda attached
- 2027-01-26: Baseline run + profiling report delivered by Redwood
- 2027-02-02: Pilot integration and initial 10% traffic split
- 2027-02-23: Joint evaluation & metrics review
- 2027-03-01: Decision meeting (Helix leadership) — options: pilot extension, enterprise contract, or pause

Risks to call out in the MAP (we will put these in the SOW):
- If procurement requires additional indemnity terms, timeline may slip by 1–2 weeks.
- If security’s KMS audit requires an on-prem validation we may need additional engineering time (TBD).

I’ll attach the draft MAP + playbook to the HubSpot deal and queue up the calendar invite for 1/21 10:00 AM PT. Ben to take the invite once Tom confirms.
